why: JavaScript units through the checker's JavaScript mode (allowJs, checkJs). index.js has no JSDoc: its module-level constant is the module unit's (WITNESS: a binding the module holds differs; before, an edit outside every unit of an untyped JavaScript file was left unassigned, which --break w1f-js restores); scale, untyped, is refused by the lint by name (untyped-js) and lane B's WITNESS stays in its row. counter.js is typed by JSDoc: double is read by both lanes (n * 2 to n + n), and the JSDoc-only edit of inc, outside every unit, is the types unit's: the file's emit differs (double), so the types unit is ASK naming counter.js, while inc's text is unchanged and has no row.
